# fix(hfp-017): job card sliders show stale values after a merge

## Task

`JobCard.vue` copies `averageImportance` / `averageSatisfaction` into local refs once, when the card first appears, and never watches the prop. `mergeCards` changes the primary card's averages but keeps its `id`, and `JobCardsTable.vue` keys cards by `card.id`, so Vue reuses the same component. The sliders and the live score keep showing the old values while the store holds the new ones. Touching a slider then sends the stale value back through `updateCardScore` and overwrites the merged average. The same applies to any other outside change, such as a future reload from the API.

Related: the store returns `currentProject` writable "so components can bind sliders", but the sliders use `updateCardScore`. Make it `readonly` like the rest, so every change goes through an action, which is where API saving will go.

## Parent Story

Stale job card sliders after a merge (found 2026-11-05, `notes/task-list.md`).

## Blocked by

Nothing.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `JobCard` watches the card's averages and resets the local slider values when they change, without fighting the user's own dragging (keep the debounce).
- [ ] Component spec: mount `JobCard`, change the card's averages from outside, and expect the sliders and score to show the new values.
- [ ] `useResearchStore` returns `currentProject` as `readonly`; nothing in `src/` writes to it directly (type-check passes).
